reason: The guard `if total_baseline <= 0: return Response(...)` sits immediately before the only compare_distributions() call in the repo (the endpoint is the sole caller of sentry.seer.endpoints.compare.compare_distributions, itself the sole caller of make_compare_distributions_request to /v1/workflows/compare/cohort), and total_baseline passed to Seer is the identical value that was tested, so no request with total_baseline zero-or-negative can reach Seer; there are no other sites, no suppression flags, and no alternate route to the Seer call. The only conceivable remaining ZeroDivisionError trigger (total_outliers == 0 while total_baseline > 0) rests on a different precondition than the reported one and on Seer code declared unavailable, so I do not claim it as a surviving path for this symptom.
